new: In a shared room the headset menu is now a short one for visitors by default: play or pause, start again, sound and effects volume, subtitles, the language in the pass story, leave the circle, line up again, close.

Staff unlock the full menu on one headset by holding both sticks down together for 2 seconds; the same hold locks it again. It also locks by itself on joining or leaving a room, at the session's end and when the headset is taken off.
The Shared dialog has a switch, Menus: limited / full, for the whole room (the full menu's Circles tab has it too). Outside a room nothing changes.
On a limited headset, developer mode's What is new no longer opens by itself.
test: Join a room in a headset: the menu (click a stick) shows the short page. Try each row at a circle.
Hold both sticks down for 2 seconds: Full menu, and no menu toggle, no stick moving, no spaceship. Hold again: Limited menu.
Unlock, take the headset off for a moment and put it back on: the menu should be limited again.
Turn Menus: full in the Shared dialog on a laptop: every headset gets the tabs back.
untested: How the 2-second hold feels on real controllers, and whether a stick held a moment longer than a click still opens the menu well.
Whether taking the headset off is noticed on a Quest (the session's hidden state) and locks the menu.
How the limited menu reads in a headset, and the pass story's language buttons there.
v213 and earlier as before: nothing since v200 has been in a headset; every synthetic voice is unheard.
